decisions.reason: It remains closely tied to the firm's core trusted second-channel identity strategy, and as a complementary software-based offer its value in the broader platform is likely still higher than its cost of staying on the market.

Mobile PDF signing still fits the move into secure digital contracting, but after several years it is somewhat more exposed to being folded into broader solutions or rationalized if stand-alone demand has stayed limited.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture sits at the center of the firm's technical capabilities and product ecosystem, so continued retention is the most likely choice.
